title: The Line Putin Is Testing: Inside NATO's Eastern Flank
gist: A Warcast episode note: a series of incidents across NATO's eastern flank over the past week has put the alliance on heightened alert, raising questions about Russian intent and NATO readiness; Andrew A. Michta assesses the threat environment and member-state responses.

insights.claim: A series of incidents across NATO's eastern flank in mid-September 2026 placed the alliance on heightened alert and raised questions about Russian intent and NATO's readiness to respond.
insights.speaker: War on the Rocks
insights.so_what: Heightened eastern-flank tension supports European defense spending and keeps a regional risk premium on assets exposed to NATO-Russia escalation.

insights.claim: NATO member states are individually calibrating their responses to Russian probing on the eastern flank, which frames the incidents as a test of where the alliance's red line lies.
insights.speaker: War on the Rocks
insights.so_what: Watch for divergent national responses as a signal of alliance cohesion and of escalation risk.
